addressed.claim_id: Defect 1 - amounts and opening balances with more than 2 decimal places were silently rounded instead of rejected; added at-most-2-decimals validation in _money via quantized comparison

Secondary issue in _money - quantize InvalidOperation could leak wrong exception type / fail for large values; perform quantize (and balance addition) under localcontext with sufficient precision and map InvalidOperation to ValueError
Fixed _money 2-dp validation to inspect Decimal exponent (reject exponent < -2) so trailing-zero over-precision like 1.2300/10.000/0.000 is rejected
Tightened date-format check to ASCII digits and exact match via fullmatch / \Z so trailing newline and non-ASCII digits no longer pass
